name: Shorecrest Property Management — Greenport 67 Steps Beach House
cardDescription: Renovated three-bedroom house a stone's throw from 67 Steps Beach in Greenport, with fireplace, modern kitchen, 1.5 baths and a large garden backing onto farm fields.

name: Shorecrest Property Management — Mattituck Estate
cardDescription: Farmhouse-modern 4,800 sq ft home on five secluded acres of lawn, meadow and woodland in Mattituck wine country, fully renovated with new kitchen and bathrooms.

name: Shorecrest Property Management — North Fork Waterfront
cardDescription: Newly built three-bedroom house with wrap-around decks, 120 feet of waterfront on Hashamomuck inlet, sunset views, two living areas and 2.5 baths; handicapped accessible.

name: Shorecrest Property Management — Peconic Bay Beach Front
cardDescription: Five-bedroom waterfront house in Southold steps from a private sandy beach on Peconic Bay, laid out for large families or groups.

name: Shorecrest Property Management — Shelter Bay Cove Waterfront
cardDescription: Restored 1920s three-bedroom house with 70 feet of waterfront on the Arshamomuck inlet of Shelter Bay in Southold; fireplace, new kitchen, central air.

name: Shorecrest Property Management — Shorecrest Beach House
cardDescription: Renovated beach house right on the Long Island Sound shore in Southold: kitchen overlooking the water, three bedrooms and two full baths downstairs, open-plan second floor with extra sleeping.

name: Terrace Cottage Colony
cardDescription: Family-run colony of rental cottages on the North Fork of Long Island in Southold, with a shared lawn and beach nearby; each cottage has its own kitchen and porch.
